requirements.name: full_name
requirements.prompt: What is the applicant's full legal name, exactly as it appears in their passport?

requirements.name: date_of_birth
requirements.prompt: What is their date of birth? Please give it as YYYY-MM-DD.

requirements.name: nationality
requirements.prompt: What is their nationality (as shown on their passport)?

requirements.name: certificate_of_sponsorship_ref
requirements.prompt: What is the certificate of sponsorship (CoS) reference number your employer gave you?

requirements.name: employer_name
requirements.prompt: What is the name of the sponsoring employer?

requirements.name: sponsor_licence_number
requirements.prompt: What is the employer's sponsor licence number?

requirements.name: job_title
requirements.prompt: What is the job title of the role you've been sponsored for?

requirements.name: occupation_code
requirements.prompt: What is the occupation code for this role, as stated on the certificate of sponsorship?

requirements.name: annual_salary_gbp
requirements.prompt: What is the annual salary offered for this role, in GBP?

requirements.name: passport_bio_page
requirements.prompt: Do you have a clear copy of the passport bio-data page ready? Please confirm.

requirements.name: english_language_evidence
requirements.prompt: Do you have evidence of your knowledge of English ready (e.g. a qualifying degree, SELT certificate, or nationality exemption)? Please confirm.
